objectives: Extend quantum theory to advanced dynamical and symmetry-based problems.
Develop controlled approximation techniques for realistic systems.

outcomes.statement: Use symmetry and angular momentum methods in quantum systems.
Apply time-independent and time-dependent perturbation theory.

syllabus.title: Symmetries and Angular Momentum
syllabus.topics: Unitary transformations, rotations, addition of angular momenta and tensor operators.

syllabus.title: Approximation Methods
syllabus.topics: Variational method, WKB approximation and perturbation theory.

syllabus.title: Scattering and Identical Particles
syllabus.topics: Scattering amplitudes, partial waves, spin, exchange symmetry and second quantisation.
